text.text_excerpt: I love The Roosevelt. Everything about this place is incredible. The rooms are nice and spacious, the service is great, and the hotel is beautiful. The room I stayed in really impressed me. The bed was so comfortable that it was hard to get of it for check out time. The room was extremely clean as was the bathroom. The shower was like a religious experience as it had side shower heads. This place is really expensive, but if you can afford it, it's definitely worth it. I look forward to staying here again sometime.

One of the best hotels I have stayed at in all aspects. Last time in we were upgraded to a king suite on the top floor without asking due to my Diamond status. The room was large, clean and comfortable. It was tastefully appointed and we had amazing views as it was on the corner of Canal and Roosevelt. Plenty of amenities you come to expect from a Waldorf property, soft robes, walk in closet, extra seating and premium toiletries. As we were treating friends to their wedding anniversary in another suite the hotel sent them complimentary champagne but also sent us a couple of bottles as well and threw in chocolate covered strawberries and macaroons. This may be the best hotel in New Orleans. I have been to the city many times and stayed at a number of hotels. This is the best or many similar category hotels. First of all, the lobby looks like 1920's Disney World. Pure magic. Even without the fabulous decor that adorns the lobby at Christmas, it is a brilliant space. Second, the rooms and hallways are much more spacious and inviting than you would expect from an old property. High ceilings, fresh air. The new-ish bathrooms with multi-jetted showers are great as well. I encountered great staff here throughout.
